# Common distributions {.unnumbered #sec-distributions}

```{=latex}
\begingroup
\raggedbottom
\noindent The distributions below are the corrected STAT3500/7500 sheet. The second gamma parameter is a rate, and the second inverse-gamma parameter is the rate in $\exp(-\beta/x)$.

\distgroup{Discrete}

\begin{distcard}{Binomial}{Discrete \textperiodcentered\ Finite}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\Bin(n,p)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$n\in\mathbb{Z}^{+}$, $p\in[0,1]$}
\distrow{Support}{$x=0,1,\ldots,n$}
\distformula{Probability mass function}{
  p(x)=\binom{n}{x}p^{x}(1-p)^{n-x}
}
\distmoments{x}{np}{x}{np(1-p)}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Geometric}{Discrete \textperiodcentered\ Unbounded}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\Geom(p)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$p\in(0,1]$}
\distrow{Support}{$x=1,2,3,\ldots$}
\distformula{Probability mass function}{
  p(x)=p(1-p)^{x-1}
}
\distmoments{x}{\frac{1}{p}}{x}{\frac{1-p}{p^{2}}}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Multinomial}{Discrete \textperiodcentered\ Finite}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\operatorname{Mult}(n,p)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$n\in\mathbb{Z}^{+}$, $p\in[0,1]^{K}$ with $\sum_{k=1}^{K}p_k=1$}
\distrow{Support}{$x_k\in\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$, $\sum_k x_k=n$}
\distformula{Probability mass function}{
  p(x)=\frac{n!}{x_1!\cdots x_K!}p_1^{x_1}\cdots p_K^{x_K}
}
\distmoments{x}{np}{x_k}{np_k(1-p_k)}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Poisson}{Discrete \textperiodcentered\ Unbounded}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\Po(\theta)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\theta>0$}
\distrow{Support}{$x=0,1,2,\ldots$}
\distformula{Probability mass function}{
  p(x)=e^{-\theta}\theta^{x}/x!
}
\distmoments{x}{\theta}{x}{\theta}
\end{distcard}

\distgroup{Continuous}

\begin{distcard}{Beta}{Continuous \textperiodcentered\ Bounded}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\BetaDist(\alpha,\beta)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\alpha,\beta>0$}
\distrow{Support}{$0<x<1$}
\distformula{Probability density}{
  p(x)=\frac{\Gamma(\alpha+\beta)}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}x^{\alpha-1}(1-x)^{\beta-1}
}
\distmoments{x}{\frac{\alpha}{\alpha+\beta}}{x}{\frac{\alpha\beta}{(\alpha+\beta)^{2}(\alpha+\beta+1)}}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Dirichlet}{Continuous \textperiodcentered\ Simplex}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\operatorname{Dir}(\alpha)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\alpha\in\R_{+}^{K}$, $\alpha_0=\sum_{k=1}^{K}\alpha_k$}
\distrow{Support}{$x_k>0$, $\sum_{k=1}^{K}x_k=1$}
\distformula{Probability density}{
  p(x)=\frac{\Gamma(\alpha_0)}{\prod_{k=1}^{K}\Gamma(\alpha_k)}\prod_{k=1}^{K}x_k^{\alpha_k-1}
}
\distmoments{x}{\frac{\alpha}{\alpha_0}}{x_k}{\frac{\alpha_k(\alpha_0-\alpha_k)}{\alpha_0^{2}(\alpha_0+1)}}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Exponential}{Continuous \textperiodcentered\ Positive}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\Exp(\lambda)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\lambda>0$}
\distrow{Support}{$x>0$}
\distformula{Probability density}{
  p(x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}
}
\distmoments{x}{\frac{1}{\lambda}}{x}{\frac{1}{\lambda^{2}}}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Gamma}{Continuous \textperiodcentered\ Positive}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\GammaDist(\alpha,\beta)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\alpha,\beta>0$, shape--rate}
\distrow{Support}{$x>0$}
\distformula{Probability density}{
  p(x)=\frac{\beta^{\alpha}}{\Gamma(\alpha)}x^{\alpha-1}e^{-\beta x}
}
\distmoments{x}{\frac{\alpha}{\beta}}{x}{\frac{\alpha}{\beta^{2}}}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Inverse gamma}{Continuous \textperiodcentered\ Positive}
\distrow{Distribution}{$x\sim\InvGamma(\alpha,\beta)$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\alpha,\beta>0$}
\distrow{Support}{$x>0$}
\distformula{Probability density}{
  p(x)=\frac{\beta^{\alpha}}{\Gamma(\alpha)}x^{-\alpha-1}e^{-\beta/x}
}
\distmoments{x}{\frac{\beta}{\alpha-1}\;(\alpha>1)}{x}{\frac{\beta^{2}}{(\alpha-1)^{2}(\alpha-2)}\;(\alpha>2)}
\distnote{The mode is $\beta/(\alpha+1)$, which is not the variance.}
\end{distcard}

\begin{distcard}{Normal}{Continuous \textperiodcentered\ Unbounded}
\distrow{Distribution}{$X\sim\Normal(\mu,\sigma^{2})$}
\distrow{Parameters}{$\mu\in\R$, $\sigma>0$}
\distrow{Support}{$x\in\R$}
\distformula{Probability density}{
  p(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}\exp\Bigl(-\frac{(x-\mu)^{2}}{2\sigma^{2}}\Bigr)
}
\distmoments{X}{\mu}{X}{\sigma^{2}}
\end{distcard}
\endgroup
```
